sentences.text: Deepu Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 19 October, 2023

Author: Krishan Pahal
Bench: Krishan Pahal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:203097
Court No. - 72
Case :- Criminal Appeal No. - 7165 of 2023
Appellant :- Deepu Singh

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Respondent :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Appellant :- Manoj Kumar Srivastava,Pramod Kumar Srivastava
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Anil Kumar Pandey
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.

Heard Mr. Pramod Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the appellant, Mr. Anil Kumar Pandey,
learned counsel for the informant/opposite party no.2 and learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent.
2.

This appeal has been filed with a prayer to set aside the impugned summoning order dated 04.05.2023 passed by learned Special Judge (SC/ST Act)/ Additional Session Judge, Banda in Complaint Case No. 254 of 2020 (Shiv Babu vs. Deepu Singh) under Sections- 376, 342, 504, 506 IPC and Section- 3(2)5 of SC/ST Act, Police Station- Chilla, District- Banda.

entities.text: Special Judge (SC/ST Act)/ Additional Session Judge, Banda
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. After arguing for some time, appellant's counsel submits that the present criminal appeal may be disposed of with a direction to file a regular bail application which may be decided keeping in view the guidelines as laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Deepu Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113396675/
1 Bureau of Investigation and another reported in 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825.
4.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Deepu Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. as well as learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 have no objection to the prayer of learned counsel for the appellant.
5. After hearing learned counsel for the parties, no case is made out for interference.

The present criminal appeal is disposed of with a direction that the appellant shall surrender before the concerned court within one month from today and in case a regular bail application is filed, the same be decided in view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in case of Satender Kumar Antil (supra).
6.

For the period of one month from today or till the time of surrender of the appellant before the concerned court, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the appellant- Deepu Singh, in the above case.

Order Date :- 19.10.2023 Saif  Deepu Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113396675/
